_about: Public-domain Johann Adam Möhler (1796-1838, Catholic theologian of Tübingen) in English for the Word Hoard: Symbolism, or Exposition of the Doctrinal Differences between Catholics and Protestants, tr. James Burton Robertson (2 vols, London: Dolman, 1843), and The Life of St. Anselm tr. Henry Rymer (1842), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 26 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Translators recorded per item where the title page names one; every printing dated or catalogued before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
